title: 3.3 Dispatch filters are executed twice
body:
This is a (multiple allowed): - [x] bug - CakePHP Version: 3.3 - Platform and Target: irrelevant ### What you did 1. Make a fresh install of `cakephp/app` (version 3.2.6) 2. In `composer.json` change `"cakephp/cakephp": "~3.2"` to `"~3.2.0"` in order to get Cake **3.2** 3. Create an [action](https://github.com/Xymanek/cake3.3-filters/blob/master/src/Controller/PagesController.php#L31-L35) and a [route](https://github.com/Xymanek/cake3.3-filters/blob/master/config/routes.php#L46) for it 4. Verify that browser gets `

Response body

` from server 5. Create a [filter](https://github.com/Xymanek/cake3.3-filters/blob/master/src/Routing/Filter/MyFilter.php) and [add](https://github.com/Xymanek/cake3.3-filters/blob/master/config/bootstrap.php#L207) it 6. Verify that browser gets `

Response body

Filter-appended content

` from server 7. In `composer.json` change `"cakephp/cakephp": "~3.2.0"` to `"~3.3.0"` in order to get Cake **3.3** 8. `composer update` 9. Open/reload the test page in browser ### Expected Behavior One would expect the behavior to remain constant and receive `

Response body

Filter-appended content

` from server ### Actual Behavior In reality the browser receives `

Response body

Filter-appended content

Filter-appended content

`. As you can see, the filter was run twice. ### Source of error I've traced the problem to the new `\Cake\Http\ActionDispatcher` class. The problem itself is that all filters are added twice. Stuff goes as follows: 1. Filters are [`\Cake\Routing\DispatcherFactory::add`ed](https://github.com/Xymanek/cake3.3-filters/blob/master/config/bootstrap.php#L204-L207) in `config/bootstrap.php` 2. The dispatcher [is created](https://github.com/Xymanek/cake3.3-filters/blob/master/webroot/index.php#L33) **with** [the filters](https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/blob/master/src/Routing/DispatcherFactory.php#L84-L86) 3. `\Cake\Routing\Dispatcher::dispatch` is [called](https://github.com/Xymanek/cake3.3-filters/blob/master/webroot/index.php#L34-L37) and it [creates a new instance](https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/blob/master/src/Routing/Dispatcher.php#L61) of `\Cake\Http\ActionDispatcher` 4. `\Cake\Http\ActionDispatcher::__construct` [adds all filters](https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/blob/master/src/Http/ActionDispatcher.php#L66-L68) from `\Cake\Routing\DispatcherFactory` 5. `\Cake\Routing\Dispatcher::dispatch` itself [adds the filters](https://github.com/cakephp/cakephp/blob/master/src/Routing/Dispatcher.php#L62-L64) (that were added to it in step 2) to `\Cake\Http\ActionDispatcher` So the end result is that the whole filter stack is added twice during runtime which causes the double execution of all event handlers, etc. I know that 3.3 depreciates filters but it shouldn't mean that the code is broken just because the project is updated to 3.3 but didn't switch to middleware yet P.S. The complete test project can be found [here](https://github.com/Xymanek/cake3.3-filters) P.P.S. I discovered this while trying to understand why DebugKit records every request twice. It took me **very** long time to figure this out so I hope I didn't make any mistake while writing this :smile:
